d: While the Supreme Court and the Madras High Court ordered the Tamil Nadu Govt to ensure the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam lamp at the Deepathoon(ancient stone lamp pillar) on Tuesday, 24th Nov, the TVK Govt of CM Vijay in Tamil Nadu defied the court orders. The lamp was eventually lit, but it was lit at the Uchi Pillaiyar temple(where it has been lit for decades) and not the Deepathoon(ancient stone lamp pillar) as ordered by the Court.
